items.q: when Herschel died, I had the opportunity of going with that band.

ctx.x: It's sentimental for you, though, isn't it?

I play it for myself because I love it. That was a masterpiece (inaudible). I -- when Herschel died, I had the opportunity of going with that band. Basie sent me a telegraph. I was afraid. I had a lot of fear, and I was with my family band, Milton Larkin Hawkins, and I just told him I couldn't make it, I didn't think I was ready.
